Smt. Kanvrayi W/o Rugharam Nayak, R/o Kumhari Darwaja,
Nagaur
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nishant Bora For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Gehlot, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 07/10/2024 1.

Petitioner is lugged and locked in F.I.R No.56/2023 of Police Station Mahila Thana, District Nagaur, for the offence under Section(s) 363, 366A, 376(2)(n) of IPC, Sections 5L/6 and 11(4)/12 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 3(2)(va) of the SC/ST Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has filed this application for restoration of liberty under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of the old Code).
2. Notice of the petition has been served upon the respondent No.2.
However, no one has appeared to oppose the bail application on her behalf.

3. I have considered the rival submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned public prosecutor and perused the record.
[2024:RJ-JD:40865] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-11300/2024]
Ravindra vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:40865) on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154820511/
1 4.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has strongly objected the different submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant and craves rejection of the applicant's bail application.
5. I have given my anxious consideration to the rival submissions with reference to material placed before me.
6. On perusal of the record and upon consideration of the submissions, it would be prima facie clear that charge-sheet in the matter has already been filed.
She has repeatedly changed her statements given at different times as per her convenience and she does not have any definite stand regarding the incident.
Various statements of victim Ms. 'R' are available on record which are hustle and bustle in nature.
Initially, on 25.08.2023, the victim stated nothing against the petitioner.
Thereafter, on 06.09.2023, her additional statement was recorded by the Investigating Officer.
No reason or occasion is mentioned in the statement while recording the additional statement, though, she leveled allegation against the petitioner.
Thereafter, in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she did not level any allegation of rape against the petitioner.
Initially, she refused to get herself examined medically.
Thereafter, in her medical examination, no evidence of force has been indicated though the victim is 16 years of age.

7. Having considered the material available on record; the arguments advanced by counsel for the applicant particularly the facts narrated above and the fact that applicant is in custody since 01.05.2024; that trial is likely to take its own considerable time and taking note of all these aspects, I do not intend to go into the merits of the matter but of the considered view that the applicant has available to him substantial grounds so as to question the prosecution case and no useful purpose would be served by [2024:RJ-JD:40865] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11300/2024]
keeping the applicant in detention for an indefinite period therefore, I am inclined to grant indulgence of bail to the petitioner at this stage.

8. Consequently, the present bail application is allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioner Ravindra S/o Mangilal, arrested in connection with the F.I.R. No.56/2023 of Police Station Mahila Thana, District Nagaur shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond and two surety bonds of sufficient amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

This order is subject to the condition that accused, within 7 days of his release, and sureties on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as copy of front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 73-Payal/-
